protocol.representation: one-hot categorical, equal weight per evaluation; no ordinal interpretation
protocol.eligibility: complete date and class in primary window; exclude all inverted dates and evaluation13 dated 2024
protocol.fit: MiniBatchKMeans; spatial block split 0.01 degree grid, 20% blocks held out
protocol.selection: maximum silhouette on held-out sample, minimum held-out cluster share 1%
protocol.stability: refit on 3 independent 80% training subsamples; ARI on same held-out observations
protocol.interpretation: retrospective classes in final-product cohort, not incidence or causal damage trajectories

report.scope: exploratory retrospective; no independent ground truth validation; sensor association diagnostic only

diagnostics.note: association only; low association does not rule out acquisition confounding
